title: Clean, scratch resistant, and protective. Easy installation.
text:
We have been using these Ailun screen protectors for a few months and I favor them over anything else that we have tried, for three reasons.

First, they are much easier to install without getting dust specs between the protector and the screen than are plastic film types. One caution, however, is to be careful to accurately center the screen protector. If it is slightly off-center, one edge may not seal well. It is less forgiving than plastic film when off-centered.

Second, these glass protectors do not scratch or dull the way that plastic film does. Unless it get broken, it stays crystal clear.

Last, this screen protector will definitely protect the screen if the phone is dropped. On the downside, the glass screen protector might break in a fall but the phone screen suffers no damage.

I have broken two of them over about six months. The screen protector stayed intact, in both mishaps, and phone still functioned, until the screen protector could be replaced.

One of the drops hit center screen and spidered out in all directions. The other hit an edge and spidered to the opposite side. (See second attached photo of the second incident.)

I am not likely to try any other brand of screen protector as long as I can find this brand. (The first photo is my most recent installation.)

title: Sharp corners
text: This is a decent screen protector, but the edges aren’t rounded enough. It looks like they did grind the edges slightly because the reflections look rounded, but it still feels like a hard corner to the touch. This is especially noticeable when you swipe up to go to the home screen, which you do all the time on the XR. It doesn’t prevent you from using the phone, but it really detracts from the tactile experience. On a slightly more nit-picky note, the shape of the screen protector doesn’t exactly match the LCD portion of the screen. For those OCD types, it’s one of those things you can’t unsee. Durability is also questionable since the first protector I put on less than a week ago now has a crack in the top right corner. I dropped the phone once from about 2ft onto asphalt. The phone was in a case and there was no other noticeable damage.

title: 8 bucks, why not?
text:
I was VERY hesitant to buy a screen protector for the iPhone XR I just got. It seems that every product on amazon has either entirely fake reviews for 5 stars, or reviews that claim the product was terrible and broke without even dropping the phone. However when I dropped my phone a couple days ago got the tiniest scratch on my screen I went to Amazon and bought this one right away since it was more neutral in reviews.
INSTALLATION: This one doesn't come with a big frame kit like some others do, but to be honest it's not rocket science. It comes with 3 screens with some guide stickers (that I didn't use) and some cleaning supplies for the screen. Basically you clean your screen with some wipes then slap the screen on. A link to a tutorial comes within the box anyway though, which I did watch.
I carefully put it on according to the directions, but somehow still managed to get a small air bubble in the upper right corner which may or may not get annoying.
It also includes a sticker that is basically for removing any extra dust particles before you put it on which is very handy, however as soon as I striped the backing of the screen to put it on my phone, dust collected all over the sticky side of the screen and I had to use the sticker to remove those first as well. Overall pretty easy installation
~4 stars for the mysterious air bubble, and also because I've had no way to test the actual durability of the screen so for now, it's gonna do the job!

title: User friendly / read on for tips I learned!
text:
This is the first time I’ve used these screen protectors (or any, really!) and I found them pretty easy to apply. I bought the 3 pack for my husband and I’s new phones and while I used the 1st one for learning purposes, by the 3rd (my husbands phone 😏) it was pretty perfected. What I learned (so you don’t have to waste any)
1: the guide stickers are kind of useless in my opinion, and while I used them for the first, I found it was much easier to line up if you took the cleanest phone and RIGHT before placing the protector down, you light up you screen. It made it very easy to see EXACTLY a where it should go.

2: if you don’t get the screen centered exactly, when your phone lights up you will get a “rainbow stripe” on the side it’s slightly not covering (see first phone, the black one) by the second phone (the red one) I had gotten it pretty perfectly centered so no glare!

3: these are SUPER easy to not get bubbles in, if you clean and dry the screen as instructed, and only place it down once, it actually basically adheres on its own!

I am so glad we got these, it feels like the phone screen as I type this and they are so inexpensive I will gladly order more if the “rainbow stripe” bothers me at all.

text: It was extremely simple placing the protector on the screen, this is not rocket science guys just follow the instructions. There is a sticker that removes any dust particles which will eliminate the possibility of permanent air bubbles until you replace it with a new screen, this is a very important step. Also, take your time placing the protector on the screen so you get it on the first try. My advice is start from the top getting both of the edges of the top of the screen first and then (as you are working your way down) center the screen making sure the (vertical) sides are even as well so you avoid the rainbow effect, then slowly start laying the screen down not putting too much pressure that you break the screen but also don't just lay it down to quick that you get air bubbles towards the middle. It can cause small air bubbles in the middle.

text: I purchased this knowing the buyer mentioned it does not cover the entire screen.  That is to be expected for a glass screen protector that is case friendly.  But this does not appear to be the correct size for the iPhone XR.  There is a gap of a half a centimeter on each side of the glass and about a quarter of a centimeter between the top and bottom parts of the glass.  Overall it appears as if it is not the right screen protector for this model.  I have owned many phones and bought many screen protectors.  This was a gift for a family member and their new phone.  I was embarrassed by how much of the actual screen is left exposed with this screen protector on it.  I have never had something that was so out of touch with reality.  I don't know how this is considered "precision" cut or anything even close to that term.  They may be proud of the so called precision  of cutting the screen protector in the same general shape of the actual screen, but it is cut too small and appears very generic and almost like a universal screen protector that could be used on ANY phone with a similar notch.  I normally would have left a positive comment about things like installation, durability, and other aspects of this item.  But the "fit" is so off that it is hard for me to care much about how it performs.  I'm more concerned about how much of the screen is still exposed and susceptible to damage.  So back to the search for a quality screen protector that is cut properly... or precisely for the iPhone XR and not just a general shape of a screen with a notch.

title: Affordable Protection & Easy Install
text:
Install was easy and seamless. I was able to get the protector centered on the first try without a single speck of dust and no bubbles. However, three weeks in, a bubble started to form at the top left edge of the screen and has since expanded about 3 inches down the left side.

Normally, bubbles can be pushed around forced out of the screen protector, but this bubble doesn't move. When pushed, the protector simply lays flat on the screen and then pops back up a second later. Since my screen protector didn't have any bubbles for three weeks after install, this is not indicative of simple trapped air. It appears that either the protector or the screen itself has a small defect that caused this bubble to form after the install. If it's the screen itself, I will get the same problem in the same location with any screen protector. If it's the screen protector, the problem will go away or be in a different spot after it's replaced.

I still gave the product 4 stars because it came with 3 screen protectors. Hopefully, this was a one-time issue. If it happens again after I install the next screen protector, I will update this review.

title: Great Value and Quality
text: This was so easy to install. I debated if I should use the 2 sticker strips to anchor the protector vs. just using a drop-in method. I actually simulated both cases several times and decided to use the 2 sticker strips. But the secret is to make it a 2-person operation. I lay down the shield with the backing still on , perfectly centered it with my two hands, held it in place, then have a 2nd person put on the 2 sticker strips tightly around the edge. Then I proceeded to lift up the protector carefully at an angle, then have the 2nd person carefully take out the backing (down slowly then sideways out). After that, I laid down the protector down from the edge then work my way up. If you do this, no bubbles, and perfect alignment. It's not as difficult as I make it sound here but I did it on the 1st try. Just practice and simulate the motion and you'll be fine. Hope this helps.

title: Simple, Inexpensive and Amazing
text:
Over the past six years Team VP has had iPhones and iPads with screens that have needed protecting. At first we used cases with built in plastic protectors until Mr. MVP decided he wanted a case for his iPhone that only had a back. We purchased these glass protectors and a whole new world opened up. We were stunned at how much better our screens looked and at how much easier they were to clean. Within two weeks all of our screens had glass protectors and within a month all of our parents' screens had them.
We do buy cases with plastic screen protectors built in, but we simply remove them and replace them with the Ailun glass protector. We found the easiest way to disassemble a plastic case is to use a hairdryer or other heat source and the plastic screen protector will peel right out. Then we use alcohol wipes to remove any excess adhesive residue. Mr. MVP follows the directions in the package of the Ailun protectors exactly, so there are really no tricks or tips there.
We have had - over the last six years - two screen protectors crack, which means this has saved two device screens from breaking. We simply peeled off the broken glass protector, cleaned the screen and put a new one on. Our devices will never be without a glass protector.

I ran my finger nail across the screen protector and felt it catch as I went over the hairline cracks. So I carefully lifted off the protector and to my amazement, the iPhone screen was 100% intact. the screen proctor had several cracks in it, but did not shatter. It came off in 1 piece and was supper simple to remove.

title: Screen Protector
text:
Pros:
So to start with this screen protector. It’s decent. It lives up to its name because my father stuck his phone on top of his car roof, and the screen protector protected his phone from a 60MPH drop across the state highway. I give it props there. It’s scratch resistant, and decent sizing to the screen.

Cons:
This screen protector has some issues. The first that I see with this, is that once this screen protector is cracked, and take it off from the phone screen.. it’s VERY thin, and it feels flimsy to the touch. Even testing it out since it’s cracked, I snapped it once more, and this thing can easily show MASSIVE crack lines even through just holding it. Not only did I do this, I then, put it pack on once more on my phone screen, but the cracks are VERY visible in the screen. I may not be able to show proof as I’m explaining this. But my experimentation holds true to what I did.

Further more, this screen protector is VERY weak to smaller falls. I’ve had to replace my screen protector four times due it falling on a regular sidewalk and the screen protector would be HEAVILY cracked with the visibility quite high in the screen itself. I’ve dropped my phone on regular concrete from the roads and still, this phone protector STILL had massive cracks.

Now again, I give this screen protector props for protecting an IPhone XR flying across the state highway and still had no damage to the regular screen.. but this alone doesn’t do it justice to be a regular screen protector for constant use.

*BUYERS BE AWARE* This screen protector is helpful in some cases.. but if slight fall. You WILL suffer the consequences.

title: The Perfect Item for Those Who Drop Their Phones on the Regular
text:
I don't normally write reviews, but I felt compelled to since I'm extremely grateful for this product. I bought these protectors almost a year ago for my iPhone 11 (to pair with an Otterbox commuter case). Now that I've had them for a while, I feel like I can comment on their quality. And their quality is excellent.

I am not someone who is careful with my phone. I drop it on the floor at home. I drop it on the train platform while on my way to work. I drop it on the train itself. I drop it on the streets occasionally. Sometimes I get into the car, can't find my phone, and then find it laying in the street somewhere nearby after it apparently slipped out of my pocket. One time I was shaking out the bed comforter, not knowing my phone was on top -- it flew across the room, hit the wall, and then dropped onto the hardwood floor. Sometimes I throw my phone when I'm trying to seem dramatic. To summarize, I commonly treat my phone in ways that should have cracked and ruined my phone 50 times over.

And yet, I have never gotten a single scratch on my phone screen. This protector has lasted through all of those incidents without showing any sign of damage.

Yesterday I was getting into my car. My phone slipped out of my pocket and fell in perfect position to be crushed as I closed the car door. I heard a crunching sound. Then I heard the sound of my phone falling hard on the concrete of the parking garage. It was a moment where I thought I had finally exceeded the protector's abilities. I picked it up, and lo and behold, there was a crack. My heart plummeted.

But then! I pulled off the screen protector. And my phone was fine! No damage whatsoever. Then I was able to go home, pull out the package, and immediately replace it (since they're kind enough to send you 3). Relief, awe, gratitude -- these are the feelings I associate with this item, which is pretty amazing for an $8 purchase.

I don't know what else you could ask for from a screen protector. The first one lasted me 10+ months of reckless phone endangerment. Considering that I'm unlikely to change my ways, I'm deeply grateful to this item for always protecting my phone for me. If you, like me, worry about the safety of your screen, I seriously recommend you purchase these.

title: phone survived fall down cliff face
text:
I managed to drop my phone down a pretty sizable cliff yesterday when it slid out of my pocket. It must have slid and tumbled for at least 100 feet, and I had to go around the bottom and climb up to retrieve it. I was sure that my phone would at least have a shattered screen, if it was even still functional, but it was fine. The protector itself clearly absorbed some damage- it was pretty cracked in some areas, but the screen underneath is basically intact. My only complaint is that since the screen protector doesn't quite cover the entire screen (I think this is a common problem with this case and the iphone XR), my phone did get scratched right at the edge. If you look really closely, you can see 2 very, very fine hairline cracks in the screen itself around the same area, but they're barely noticeable. All in all though, I think it's seriously impressive that the phone survived as well as it did.
I do have to give credit to the case I was using too, which went over the corners and protected the screen that way. It could also be sheer luck, or the sturdiness of the model of phone, but I think it's safe to say that this screen protector helped save my phone.

title: Running and gunning with the best in your pocket!
text:
Now I am, by both profession and passion, what one might call a “climber” or “trespasser”. You may see me doing my thing and yell, “Hey! That guy isn’t supposed to be in there! Get out!” Nothing overtly criminal, I just enjoy exploring hard to reach places.
Anyway, this New Year my associates and myself decided to enter a sports stadium that had been closed for the holidays. Why? Because the roof of the commentators booth happened to be one of the best views in town. At night, in the crisp winter air, one could see the fireworks go off as the New Year was rung in all over town. The cascading lights peppered the darkness as we watched. Truly a memorable experience.
Now, in order to get to this spot one has to crawl, hop over, climb, and jump through a series of gates and fences of various sizes. Also as it was New Year’s Eve we had to also contend with snow and ice that had been left untreated all over the area. My compatriots and I fell and slipped multiple times as we sought to beat the clock to reach the coveted viewpoint before the bells.
After a memorable evening we returned home early in the morning. I am also an avid Tetris player and had decided in my sleep deprived state to run a few rounds before sleep took me. As I looked at my screen I lamented as I saw a series of spidery cracks scattered across the glass. Heartbroken, I realized it must have happened during our midnight escapades. Defeated, I pulled back this screen protector to discover that the touchscreen underneath was, for lack of a better word, untouched. The thick plastic of the protector had taken the entire demand of my activities and, living up to it’s purpose, had given it’s life to defend my screen. The screen was in pristine condition and I couldn’t have been more satisfied with this product.
In short, if you are planning to take part in activities up to and similar to the ones described above you can feel confident that it will deliver. To close I shall leave you with a quote from Jango Fett in regards to his Clones that I firmly believe applies well to these products, “They’ll do their job well, I’ll guarantee that.”

text:
First the good- these were easy to apply. They come with everything you need to apply them also.

Now the bad- I'm not rough on my phone. The worst I do with it is throwing it in my purse. I hardly ever drop it and when I do it typically lands on carpet. So I don't need much in a screen protector.

The screen protector I had on my phone before I bought these ones lasted me 6 months before cracking. The first one I applied from this pack lasted me a week. I put my phone in my purse to un errands and when I pulled my phone out there was a divit type crack on the side that had spiderwebbed out. I assumed my phone had hit my keys at a weird angle so I just changed the screen protector. This one cracked again within another week. This time I don't even know how it cracked. There's a crack going straight across the screen and another at the very top of the phone that looks like a chunk of the glass somehow came out.

TLDR- These are not durable at all. I haven't changed my habits from my old screen protector to these new ones and yet every time I look at my phone I notice a new crack or scratch.

All that being said- my actual phone screen is fine. So these do protect your phone. But I've gone through two protectors in less than a month. I refuse to use my last one until the one on my phone is completely ruined.

So if you look at what they're for- they work. My phone screen is not cracked. But I also don't want my screen protector to scratch or crack just because I look at it wrong. Will be using a different brand from now. Do not recommend.

title: Saved the phone screen!
text:
After about 13 yrs with a phone I finally managed to drop it screen side down on the sidewalk, despite having the wallet type cover which should have been closed to protect the screen. Picked it up to find the screen edges chipped, but it looked ok otherwise. Later that night, I noticed cracks in the screen - but no - it was not the screen - but the screen protector! The Ailun covering took the hit and had cracked in several places. But due to the thickness, it saved the actual phone glass!

At midnight I sat down and put the second one on the phone - easy peasy

However - one recommendation I would make is DO NOT use the sticky tabs. Found out putting one of these screen protectors on the first time. Bypass step 3 in the instructions as those things left a smeared sticky residue on the brand new phone screen.
I had a handful of packaged wipes for use on device / monitor screens. Spent about five minutes using several to remove the residue. Then just blew gently to dislodge any dusty bits, though the wipes had mostly accomplished that.
Despite the thickness, have had no problems typing/swiping the screen.

Registered on website for extra 12 months of warranty coverage. Product cracked sometime between last night (when phone was last used) and this afternoon (when discovered). Used the Ailun customer support page to place a warranty claim, but it's a janky site that just continuously displays "Processing, please wait...." and never offers anything more. There's an accompanying "chat"-like bubble in the bottom right corner that displays the same message.... but it never changes!

Product insert promises a response within 24 hours. We'll see. If they come through and honor the warranty, I'll give them 5 stars because they ARE good screen protectors. Just make SURE your screen is SPOTLESS before installing them, or you end up with air bubbles that are a pain to get rid of.

UPDATE- It has now been 5 days, with no contact from vendor. I'll try emailing their customer support directly.

NEWER UPDATE - I reached out via email, got a response the next morning, and Ailun shipped me a whole package of three (3) new screen protectors. No questions, no quibbling. Their website was the problem (to be fair, it may be the security settings on my own browser that kept the CSR submission from going through - who knows?). Upped my rating to 5 stars!

Then I got closer and let it "stick". A little tap to the center of the screen and like magic the protector sealed itself to the edges. I used the foam pouch the protector came in to gently smooth a couple of bubbles to the side. Very easy and no hassle. Like the description says, the protector DOES NOT GO ALL THE WAY TO THE EDGES of my iPhone 11 because of the curved screen. It's a perfect fit and I look forward to worrying less about my screen getting any more scratches!

title: Best value for price
text:
Ailun Glass Screen Protector is one of those products that surprises. The protectors outperform expectations in terms of protection and ease-of-installation. Originally purchased for use with a phone used as a test device. Putting the screen protector on the phone was much easier than expected. The instructions were straightforward and the adhering side was not so tacky or sticky that excess air bubbles could not be pushed out with a fingernail. Less than an hour later the device was dropped from a 4 ft height and landed screen-side down on hard tile. At a minimum, I expected to have to scrape the protector off and replace it. But there were no cracks or shatter-stars or any screen damage at all.

Anecdotally, the screen protector also seems water-resistant, which was surprising for the price. In previous purchases of less expensive screen protectors, they tended to lose adhesion when exposed to water. The Ailun Glass Screen Protector maintained adhesion to the screen and no bubbles formed under the surface. Best value for the price. 5/5 stars, will definitely purchase again.

This screen protector says it’s made for iPhone 11 or iPhone XR, but there are 2-3 mm of exposed glass on every side of my iPhone XR screen even when it’s in its case, so the phone is not well protected from drop damage. title: PERFECT, Exactly as Described!!!
text: Scratched my new iPhone XR within one week and had no idea how.  Maybe my skin was rough?!  One of the scratches was nearly the whole length of the phone. AGH!  Had to get a new phone because my LG 3G phone was going to be cut off by AT&T this month to make way for 4G and 5G capacity. We'd already cancelled our landline years ago, so I HAD to have a phone!  Was anxious to get this screen protector asap to prevent more scratches on my brand new iPhone!  Could hardly stand waiting the 5 business days, so went looking for some other tempered glass screen protector in 3 big box stores.  Guess what?  No way!  The ONLY ones left on the shelves were NOT tempered glass AND they cost ~$40 (if you include tax) for only ONE screen protector!!!  So if you goof on applying the ONE, you've just lost $40.  So I waited another day and voila, the package came early in the day, not 9p, so I could go get it, yea!  The kit has everything you need.  Watch the 90 second film next to the product on Amazon to see exactly how to install it.  Watch it twice.  Do everything the same way.  It's as easy as shown.  I did have one tiny bubble I couldn't get out, but only nearsighted people can see it, because it's about a 32nd of an inch in diameter.  Best of all, one of the reviews said you wouldn't be able to see the scratches anymore and that's TRUE!!!  I guess the adhesive goes into the scratches and mutes them, thank goodness.  And I still have two more screen protectors with all the wet cloths, dry cloths, lint removers, extra strip stickies to hold the screen while positioning.  But you don't need the strip stickies, because the screen is stiff enough to just hold it on the edges without touching either side, just like the film shows.  My husband has to replace his LG 3G phone before Dec., so he went ahead and also bought a new iPhone XR.  Now he has all he needs to protect his screen also!  This is a GREAT DEAL!

title: Saved my phone on day 1 of use
text:
I'm a little slow with the times. With my most recent phone being an Xr, I don't really understand what's so great about newer phones. However, I work in an environment where having a fancy expensive phone like the latest and greatest could be a catastrophe. Commercial vehicle tire shops require a lot of hard impacts with tools and vehicles, and rocks on the ground. The first day I went into work with one of these protects on, laid down under a truck in the shop, and got up, screen protector had taken the blunt and cracked.

I waited a few days before replacing it and to my surprise, there was no damage to the screen. Replaced it and a few weeks go by. Rough environment, cold, wet, lots of gravel on a road service. Sceen protector cracks, lots of little fractures. That was about a month ago. Still using that same 2nd protector writing this review about to apply the 3rd one in the package. I have no complaints. Easy to apply, reasonably cheap insurance for the phone, what more can I say?

You get 3 protectors in the package, with a unique cleaning and drying cloth for each application. If you have a lot of fractures, it may not come off in one piece, but I've had no trouble removing it with just my finger nail and some light pulling. Do make sure you start pressure on the center when installing. It practically gets rid of the air bubbles itself. You will have to help some out though.

I am so glad I found Ailun Glass Screen Protectors on Amazon!) These screen protectors can be a bit challenging to install and get perfectly centered on the phone, but it gets easier with practice. After a month or two, the adhesive on the screen protector can start wearing out along the edges, creating air bubbles along the side of the screen. When this happens, it's easy to gently lift off and remove the old screen protector and replace it with a new one. I always make sure I have at least one replacement screen protector on hand at all times. The Ailun screen protectors will definitely protect your screen in the event you drop your phone. Glass is crystal clear and install is simple, but the cheap alignment stickers that come with the kit are too thin to do any good. Back when I used to install plastic screen protectors on my iPhone it was an entire operation. With these glass covers, it's an entirely different experience. Yes, you still need to clean the screen before applying, but installing these is so much easier. All you do is line up the cover to the iPhone screen and simply drop it in. No bubbles. No need to rub it repeatedly to make sure it adheres. Nothing like that. It's so simple.

In terms of protection, I'd argue this glass cover is superior. On a recent instance where I dropped by phone, I thought my screen had cracked. But nope, it was just this glass screen protector that had cracked. It took it in the chin to save my iPhone. I simply removed it, replaced it with a new one, and it was ready to go.
